definitions.explanation: A fine, soft fiber produced by silkworms, or fabric made from this fiber.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{絹|きぬ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This kimono is made of silk.

examples.japanese: {絹|きぬ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{絹|きぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Silk feels nice to the touch.

notes:
{絹|きぬ} refers to silk, the luxurious natural fiber produced by silkworms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {絹|きぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: silk kimono
- {絹|きぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような: silk-like, silky
- {絹|きぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧: silky texture

COMPOUNDS:
- {絹|きぬ}⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧: silk thread
- {絹|きぬ}⟦{織物|おりもの}→織物：10583_orimono⟧: silk fabric/textile
- ⟦{生糸|きいと}→生糸：27719_kiito⟧: raw silk
- {絹|きぬ}⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧: silken tofu (smooth variety)

CULTURE:
Japan has a long history of silk production (⟦{養蚕|ようさん}→養蚕：27720_yousan⟧). Traditional Japanese clothing, especially formal ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧, often uses silk. The Tomioka Silk Mill ({富岡製糸場|とみおかせいしじょう}) is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
